newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: North Korean defector leaves China -- TV.
newsitem.headline: North Korean defector leaves China -- TV.

text.p: North Korea's top ideologue left Beijing on Tuesday nearly five weeks after seeking asylum in Seoul's Beijing embassy, Yonhap Television News quoted a South Korean government source as saying.
The source gave no details about where Hwang Jang-yop was heading but made clear it was not South Korea.
A foreign ministry spokesman declined comment on the report. He said China and South Korea would announce Hwang's departure after he had left Beijing.
South Korea's influential Chosun Ilbo newspaper said Hwang and an aide who sought asylum with him slipped out of South Korea's consulate overnight.
On Monday a senior South Korean official said Hwang would stay in a third country "for a considerable period of time" before coming to South Korea.
Hwang is the most senior North Korean official to flee the impoverished North.
